instruction: A lidded sugar bowl thrown in bone-white porcelain with a fluted melon-ribbed body and two small scrolled loop handles. The domed lid carries a sculpted rosebud finial and a hand-painted cobalt vine border tracing each rib, finished with a thin gold rim line. The glaze is glossy with tiny crazing lines near the foot ring.
